decks.description: Find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters

cards.question: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

solutions.name: Sliding Window (Optimal)
solutions.explanation: Use a hash map to store the most recent index of each character. When we encounter a duplicate, jump the left pointer to the position after the previous occurrence. This eliminates unnecessary iterations and achieves O(n) time with at most n operations.

solutions.name: Sliding Window
solutions.explanation: Use a hash set to track characters in the current window. When we encounter a duplicate, shrink the window from the left by removing characters until the duplicate is removed. This maintains a valid window of unique characters.
